notes: Wording 2 paraphrases wording 1 with the same facts, so wording differences measure phrasing alone. {country} is filled by the country slot, or omitted in the no-country condition.

PR.frame: On 12 June 2025, {actors} gathered {place}{country} to protest {grievance}. {evidence} The gathering ended by evening.

wordings: Participants remained peaceful throughout.
The demonstrators stayed nonviolent for the entire event.

levels.evidence: Minor physical contact reported and disputed
wordings: Some reports mentioned scuffles, but organizers said the event was peaceful.
A few accounts described brief pushing and shoving, but organizers said the gathering stayed peaceful.

levels.evidence: Property damage occurred; responsible party unknown
wordings: A nearby car was damaged; it is unclear whether participants or bystanders were responsible.
A car parked nearby was damaged, but it is not known whether demonstrators or passersby caused the damage.

levels.evidence: Violence attributed to participants but unconfirmed
wordings: Witnesses said some participants threw stones, though this could not be confirmed.
According to unconfirmed witness accounts, several demonstrators threw stones.
Participants threw stones and set a parked car on fire.
Demonstrators hurled stones and set fire to a parked car.

BV.frame: On 12 June 2025, members of an armed group opened fire on a group of people {place}{country} {time}. {evidence} Two people were killed.

wordings: The people attacked were unarmed local residents.
Those targeted were local residents who carried no weapons.

levels.evidence: Identity of the people attacked disputed
wordings: Local officials described the people attacked as residents, while the attackers claimed they were militia members.
The attackers said those targeted belonged to a militia, but local officials said they were ordinary residents.

levels.evidence: Whether the people attacked were armed is unknown
wordings: It is unclear whether the people attacked were armed.
It is not known whether those targeted carried weapons.

levels.evidence: People attacked reported armed but unconfirmed
wordings: Witnesses said some of the people attacked carried rifles, though this could not be confirmed.
According to unconfirmed witness accounts, several of those targeted were carrying rifles.

levels.evidence: People attacked confirmed armed and fought back
wordings: The people attacked were members of a rival armed group and returned fire.
Those targeted belonged to a rival armed group and fired back.
